listing.title: SZL Holdings Platform Connector
listing.short_description: Connect Salesforce to the SZL Holdings intelligence platform — sync accounts, opportunities, and signals bi-directionally with Alloy and Lyte Command Center.
listing.long_description: The SZL Holdings Platform Connector bridges Salesforce CRM with the SZL enterprise intelligence stack. Sync Salesforce Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, and Cases directly into Alloy workflows. Surface PRISM risk scores, Lyte signals, and AI-generated insights as custom fields on your CRM records. Trigger Alloy automation from Salesforce process flows and receive enriched artifacts back as Salesforce Documents.
